annotation.title_clean: New ETSI standard protects AI systems from evolving cyber threats
annotation.title_en: New ETSI standard protects AI systems from evolving cyber threats
named_instruments_referenced: NCSC Guidelines for Secure AI System Development
UK AI Cyber Security Code of Practice
ETSI TS 104 223 Baseline Cyber Security Requirements for AI Models and Systems
annotation.summary_en: NCSC blog announcing ETSI's publication of a technical specification and report on baseline cyber security requirements for AI models and systems, developed with UK DSIT. It defines 13 principles across five lifecycle stages and signals the UK Code of Practice will be updated to mirror it.
key_provisions_or_claims: ETSI specification sets baseline security requirements across the AI lifecycle for all supply chain stakeholders
13 core security principles grouped into five lifecycle stages
Accompanying technical report supports implementation with mappings to international frameworks
UK Code of Practice and Implementation Guide to be updated to mirror ETSI documents
Next step is a European standard with other standards bodies
